name: recurgence
title: recurgence
blurb: paint a 3×3 seed pattern and it recurses forever: every kept cell contains an exact copy of the whole pattern, which contains copies of itself, without end. click any cell to zoom in — because the fractal is generated fresh at each level instead of sampled from an image, there's no precision wall, so the descent never blurs out. let it auto-recurse and watch it fall through its own reflection. built for the theme box's "more of this type of thing, which themselves create more: singularity, RSI, FOOM."
